tei:div.tei:p: )'phags pa bkra shis brgyad pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bzhugs so// las gang zhig rtsom pa na thog mar 'di tshar gcig brjod na grub pa bde ba yid bzhin du byed par 'gyur bas ci nas yid la bya'o// oṃ/ snang srid rnam dag rang bzhin lhun grub pa'i// bkra shis phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun 'phags pa'i tshogs// kun la phyag 'tshal bdag cag bkra shis shog /sgron me'i rgyal po rtsal brtan don grub dgongs// byams pa'i rgyan dpal dge grags dpal dam pa// kun la dgongs pa rgya cher grags pa can// lhun po ltar 'phags rtsal grags dpal dang ni// sems can thams cad la dgongs grags pa'i dpal// yid tshim mdzad pa rtsal rab grags dpal te// mtshan tsam thos pas bkra shis dpal 'phel ba// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dpal gzhon nu dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// spyan ras gzigs dbang mgon po byams pa'i dpal// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po 'phags mchog kun tu bzang*// utpal rdo rje pad dkar klu shing dang*// nor bu zla ba ral gri nyi ma yi// phyag mtshan legs bsnams bkra shis dpal gyi mchog /byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen gdugs mchog bkra shis gser gyi nya// 'dod 'byung bum bzang yid 'ong ka ma la// snyan grags dung dang phun tshogs dpal be'u// mi nub rgyal mtshan dbang bsgyur 'khor lo ste// rin chen rtags mchog brgyad kyi phyag mtshan can// phyogs dus rgyal ba mchod cing dgyes bskyed ma// sgeg sogs ngo bo dran pas dpal spel ba'i// bkra shis lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa chen po bde 'byung srid med bu// mig stong ldan dang rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// 'phags skyes po dang klu dbang mig mi bzang*// rnam thos sras te lha rdzas 'khor lo dang*// tri shu la dang mdung thung rdo rje can// pi waṃ ral gri mchod rten rgyal mtshan 'dzin// sa gsum gnas su dge legs bkra shis spel// 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag deng 'dir bya ba rtsom pa la// gegs dang nye bar 'tshe ba kun zhi nas// 'dod don dpal 'phel bsam don yid bzhin 'grub// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog

/ldang tshe brjod na de'i nyin don kun 'grub// nyal tshe brjod na rmi lam bzang por mthong*// g.yul du 'jug tshe brjod na phyogs las rgyal// bya ba brtsam dus brjod na 'dod don 'phel// rgyun du brjod na tshe dpal grags 'byor shis// bde legs phun tshogs bsam don yid bzhin 'grub// sdig sgrib kun byang mngon mtho nges legs kyi// don kun 'grub par rgyal ba mchog gis gsungs// rab tshes me sprel zla ba 3 tshes 3 gza' nyi ma dang rgyu skar rgyal gyi dus bzang po'i cha la 'jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i yid mtsho las byung ba nor bu'i do shal chen po maṅga laṃ/// /
